Messages.Author: Oscar Garza
Messages.Body:
1. Tegyrius (basic) becomes anarch. When he merges is he a Camarilla
Justicar or does he remain anarch?

I'm guessing the advanced text takes priority.

2. Quira, The Bitch Queen employs an Infernal Familiar. She then
successfully completes a Dive into Madness at inferior (granting her
superior Dementation) and untaps. If she plays another card requiring
Dementation that turn does the Familiar gain an investment counter?

I'm guessing no, since the Dive itself grants her the DEM and would not
require her to use the Familiar.

oscar

Messages.Author: Colin McGuigan
Messages.Body:
Oscar Garza wrote:
> 1. Tegyrius (basic) becomes anarch. When he merges is he a Camarilla
> Justicar or does he remain anarch?
>
> I'm guessing the advanced text takes priority.

Camarilla. Correct. (It is the "most recent" effect)

> 2. Quira, The Bitch Queen employs an Infernal Familiar. She then
> successfully completes a Dive into Madness at inferior (granting her
> superior Dementation) and untaps. If she plays another card requiring
> Dementation that turn does the Familiar gain an investment counter?

No. She has DEM due to the DiM, she does not need to use the familiar
for it.

--Colin McGuigan
